metaTitle: Clean, Backflush and Store a Water Filter
description: Backflush, dry and store a water filter correctly, keep it from freezing and know when to replace it so it keeps protecting you on trips.
directAnswer: Backflush with clean water when flow slows and after trips, dry the filter fully, store it cool and loose and never let a hollow-fiber filter freeze. Replace it after freezing, damage or its rated capacity.
